race.title: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
race.verdict: GO OUT is a better performer on all-weather than turf and, with the booking of Colin Keane catching the eye, he is taken to resume winning ways in an open handicap. Final Boss is feared most back up to 1m after improving here last time, while Phoenix Pairc is also respected with Billy Lee back in the saddle. GO OUT (FR) FINAL BOSS (IRE) PHOENIX PAIRC (IRE)
